Magnesium is a typical metal.
Three reactions of magnesium are listed.
1
magnesium + oxygen →substance X
2
magnesium + steam →substance X + substance Y
magnesium + sulfuric acid →substance Y + substance Z
3
What is substance Z?
A
hydrogen
B
magnesium oxide
C
magnesium sulfate
D
water
